trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Use the remaining filter and resolve any unchecked PS5 trophy. Once the other 54 are earned, sync the PS5 list and confirm the platinum before marking it here.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #01 Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Start with the opening story objective. Follow Gone Fishing to its completion screen before leaving the mission.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #02 Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_note: Opening mission. Check replay access before relying on a later attempt.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Follow the main objectives through the first chapter transition. Once the chapter trophy pops, make a separate save if the game offers a slot.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #03 Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 1 milestone. Verify the unlock before moving into Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Advance the main story through the second chapter transition. Check your PS5 list before starting optional cleanup so this milestone is recorded.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #04 T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 2 milestone. Verify the unlock before moving into Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Keep following main objectives until the third chapter closes. If you pause to explore, return to the main objective marker to continue the chapter.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #05 Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 3 milestone. Verify the unlock before moving into Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the last active main objective of Chapter 4 and wait for the chapter transition to register. Keep a separate save going into the final stretch.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #06 Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 4 milestone. Verify the unlock before starting the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the story finale and wait for the mission result. Preserve a save before launching it if possible, since the description does not establish post-story access or replay.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #07 You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_note: Final mission required. Keep a save before the finale if the game offers one.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: When Breakfast Run appears in your story objectives, finish the mission before returning to free roam. Check the PS5 trophy list if the unlock does not appear with the result.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #08 Trust
trophies.missable_note: Breakfast Run is required. Check whether the mission can be replayed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Follow The Cartel Heist objective through its closing result. Track it separately from the free-roam bank vault counter, which has a different unlock condition.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #09 Break the Bank
trophies.missable_note: The Cartel Heist is required. Check whether the mission can be replayed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play when the mission is available. A completed chapter alone is not useful evidence for this specific mission entry, so verify the PS5 unlock separately.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #10 Family Matters
trophies.missable_note: Child’s Play is required. Check whether the mission can be replayed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Look for Headliners in the available story objectives. Stay through the closing objective and verify the named mission registered before ticking this entry.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #11 DWNFALL
trophies.missable_note: Headliners is required. Check whether the mission can be replayed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission named VCIA Takedown when it enters your objectives. The separate airport departure trophy has its own condition and should be verified independently.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #12 Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_note: VCIA Takedown is required. Check whether the mission can be replayed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Take Operation Savage Glory through its final objective. Preserve a save beforehand if available, because the trophy list gives neither a chapter assignment nor a replay guarantee.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #13 Snow Storm
trophies.missable_note: Operation Savage Glory is required. Check whether the mission can be replayed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Use the game's completion total as the target and keep trophy progress separate. Clear known unfinished strands, activities and collections first, then check which actions actually move the game total.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #14 A Long Road
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Record the stunt count before a session, then check which attempts advance it. Work in small batches toward 250 and switch objectives if repeats stop moving the tracker.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #15 Cunning Stunts
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the nine activity types and check for progress after each first attempt. Keep a list of types credited so variants of one activity do not take the place of a new type.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #16 Master of None
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Use the Shooting Range challenge roster and log gold medals only. Work through all 42 challenges, then revisit entries where you have a finish but no gold medal.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #17 The Shootist
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Track wins by location across the 14 Top Fun Drone Race sites. Once a site is credited, move to another location so repeat wins do not obscure gaps.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #18 Top Fun
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Keep a list of distinct race events you won. After a victory is credited, pick a different event until the list has 20 unique entries.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #19 Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal's fishing challenge when the prompt appears. Check the result for a win over Cal before moving on, since fishing elsewhere is a separate activity.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #20 Baited My Tackle
trophies.missable_note: Requires a win against Cal. Try the challenge when offered and check whether it can be repeated.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Pick one arcade game and play to its end state. If an attempt stops short, retry the same title so you can learn what counts as a full completion.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #21 Stick Fiddler
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's strand until its final mission result. Check for a follow-up after each encounter and preserve a save before progressing the story if a marker is still open.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #22 Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.missable_note: Requires Andy’s final mission. Follow up when the strand becomes available.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Prioritize Kenton's available strand objectives and verify the trophy after the finale. Keep a separate save before a major story transition while the strand is unfinished.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #23 This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.missable_note: Requires Kenton’s final mission. Follow up when the strand becomes available.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's mission chain through the final result. A single encounter is only a checkpoint, so track the strand until PS5 confirms the trophy.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #24 The Lone Rider
trophies.missable_note: Requires Billy’s final mission. Follow up when the strand becomes available.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Track completed strands by contact across Leonida and count a strand only after its finale. Use the named stranger trophies as leads and verify which completions actually add to the eight.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #25 Strangers & Freaks
trophies.missable_note: Requires eight finished stranger strands. Follow up on available strands and track their finales.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish each available objective in Randy's chain and look for any follow-up. Check the trophy after the finale and keep a save if an open objective could become unavailable.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #26 Supply & Demand
trophies.missable_note: Requires Randy’s final mission. Follow up when the strand becomes available.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Keep a slot for Tyrone in your stranger checklist and finish the chain as its objectives appear. Check availability before moving past major story transitions.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #27 Spin On This!
trophies.missable_note: Requires Tyrone’s final mission. Follow up when the strand becomes available.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Keep a ledger of the 18 meditation sites as you explore Leonida. After interacting at each new spot, check whether the tracker advanced before leaving the area.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #28 Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Start with Bret's available hunt objective and follow the target the game identifies. Check that Bret's hunt registers before counting unrelated wildlife encounters.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #29 Fair Game
trophies.missable_note: Bret’s unique animal is required. Check availability when his hunt appears.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Sort your findings by card set and work on missing cards in the closest set first. Track three completed sets separately from the number of loose cards found.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #30 Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Log each credited WAiNK location during exploration. Try a fresh location if a repeated interaction leaves the total unchanged, and check milestones on the way to 100.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #31 You WAiNKer!
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Track challenges credited by the game in groups of ten. When progress stalls, try an unfinished challenge and check the result against the PS5 count.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #32 One Last Thing
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Set up the in-game attempt while the partner is present. Make sure the four-star state is reached before escape and that the partner is still with you when it clears.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #33 Hot Together
trophies.missable_note: Requires your partner during the four-star escape. Try it while the partner is available.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Pick three eligible shops in the game and plan the route before starting. Keep the same wanted sequence active through all three and restart the attempt if it drops between shops.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #34 Retail Therapy
trophies.missable_note: Requires your partner throughout a three-shop sequence. Try it while the partner is available.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Track new vehicle discoveries separately from vehicles owned or registered. Check the PS5 count when trying a different model and focus subsequent sessions on discoveries that register.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #35 Whip It Good
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Use an in-game encounter with enough eligible enemies present to attempt all five within one Combat Focus activation. If the activation ends early, treat the next use as a new attempt.
trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #36 Gunslinger
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #37 Catch Me If You Can
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #38 Challenging Tank
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #39 Sneakthief
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #40 Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #41 A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.missable_note: The published description gives no chapter cutoff or unique story requirement.

trophies.source: Exophase / PSNProfiles · Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophy list · #51 Ten Pin
